integrity: Analytical necessary-and-sufficient proof with reproducible local moment and direct-sum matrix checks; independent scientific audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact static, Hermitian, open finite diamond chains only; all four hub-arm hoppings at every link nonzero; no bypass edges. Does not address approximate robustness, extra edges, non-Hermitian/time-dependent dynamics or independence of historical priority.
title: Exact caging criterion for arbitrarily disordered finite diamond chains
